title: Feedback gain for FIFO timing channels with non-exponential service
decision_reason: Separated adversarial self-pass found a shifted-exponential obstruction to the proposed universal formulation. Do not accept this statement. A precisely sourced repair with independent status corroboration is still needed.

problem_fingerprint.dimension: Continuous time; arbitrary block length n
problem_fingerprint.regularity_and_data_class: Absolutely continuous S; finite positive mean and finite differential entropy
problem_fingerprint.boundary_or_initial_conditions: Initially empty, work-conserving, nonpreemptive server, unlimited waiting buffer
problem_fingerprint.parameter_range: Every such non-exponential service law, including unbounded support
problem_fingerprint.quantifiers: For every admissible non-exponential S, C_F(S)>C(S)
problem_fingerprint.normalization: log2(M_n)/T_n, E[d_n]<=T_n; average over uniform messages and service
problem_fingerprint.observable_or_norm: Supremum achievable rate with average decoding error tending to zero
problem_fingerprint.limit_regime_and_order: Fix S, take block lengths and T_n to infinity with error tending to zero, then supremize rates

problem_fingerprint.computational_model_and_dependencies: Unrestricted coding/decoding; causal feedback; no packet payload, no secrecy constraint, no computational bound

statement_source_and_scope_match: AV §III p.14 poses strict feedback gain outside exponential service; ST §I restates the hypothesis and §V leaves unbounded service laws unresolved. Absolute continuity and finite differential entropy exclude infinite-capacity singular/degenerate cases. One general continuous-time conjecture; do not count individual distributions or the discrete-time analogue separately.
proposed_statement_text: Let S be a nonnegative absolutely continuous service time with 0<E[S]<infinity and finite differential entropy. For the initially empty, work-conserving FIFO single-server timing channel d_i=max(a_i,d_(i-1))+S_i with iid service independent of the message, define C(S) and C_F(S) as vanishing-average-error capacities in bits per expected time of the final departure, respectively without feedback and with causal noiseless instantaneous departure feedback. If S is not exponential, must C_F(S)>C(S)?
applied_significance: Determines whether acknowledgement timing can increase the asymptotic throughput of information encoded in packet arrival times through a stochastic server.

issues_found: The universal statement includes S=a+E with a>0 and E exponential. For any exponential-queue no-feedback code with arrivals b_i and departures z_i, arrivals a_i=b_i+(i-1)a through the shifted-service queue yield departures d_i=z_i+i*a, by the FIFO recursion. The code conveys the same message with total duration increased by n*a. The feedback capacity expression also transforms by precisely that time cost. This appears to give no feedback gain for a non-exponential law.
Finite differential entropy does not exclude shifted exponentials.
No independent source was found confirming a repaired essential-infimum-zero formulation.
Bound equality is not operational capacity equality; LCFS remains a distinct model.
issues_resolved: Read AV pp.6 and 14 visually, retaining the expected final-departure normalization.
Distinguished the bounded-support theorem and the bound-conjecture refutation from the proposed universal claim.
